_what: Which committed receipt each card replays (cards, by device name) and which an unlisted card of a recorded architecture replays (architectures, "major.minor"). Read by this fixture's parity tests and by tools/advect_wrf471_oracle/recapture_receipt.py, which adds a card here when it installs that card's first capture. certified_stand_in records a receipt of an older architecture that gates exactly as a certified one, standing in for certified receipts recorded as not re-pinned (user ruling 2026-11-17: the sm_120 receipts can be re-recorded only on an RTX 5090; the RTX A6000 receipt verifies kernel edits meanwhile); recapture_receipt.py --install of a certified receipt drops both records.

gpu-receipt-sm86.json.reason: user ruling 2026-11-17: the RTX 5090 receipts can be re-recorded only on an RTX 5090, which no lane can reach; the RTX A6000 (sm_86, pb) is recorded and verified in their place, so a kernel edit here moves this receipt only through a capture on the A6000 that reproduces every production word
